name: Crane
description: Unmanned and manned WHPs use pedestal/deck cranes for supply-boat transfers, wireline/coiled-tubing equipment and module handling. PALFINGER AHC crane data gives printed capacity/radius/wire ranges; Ramboll/NPD gives crane sizes by UWHP type. No page read gave a quantified laydown-area specification.

specifications.metric: Pedestal/deck crane - PALFINGER active h — SWL range
specifications.basis: PALFINGER can deliver AHC cranes with SWL ranging from 5 to 250 tons and wire capacities exceeding 3,000 meters

specifications.metric: Pedestal/deck crane - PALFINGER active h — Hoisting capacity
specifications.basis: Hoisting capacity up to 250 metric tons

specifications.metric: Pedestal/deck crane - PALFINGER active h — Jib radius
specifications.basis: Jib radius up to 50 meters (engineering to order)

specifications.metric: Pedestal/deck crane - PALFINGER active h — Main winch wire capacity
Pedestal/deck crane - PALFINGER active h — Winterisation temperature
specifications.basis: PALFINGER has developed a range of innovative solutions that ensure safe and reliable performance at temperatures as low as -50 °C

specifications.metric: UWHP pedestal crane sizing by platform t — Type 0 crane sizing
specifications.basis: The platform has a crane sized for coiled tubing equipment (50-60 tonnes)

specifications.metric: UWHP pedestal crane sizing by platform t — Type 1 crane sizing
specifications.basis: The platform has a crane sized for well intervention equipment (10-50 tonnes)

specifications.metric: UWHP pedestal crane sizing by platform t — Type 2 crane sizing
